text: The check at the end of a unit is called "Checkpoint" (no "Unit N" prefix), shown with its unit's title, for example Checkpoint · What the Bible Is. Supersedes the "Unit 2 Checkpoint" wording in ui.naming.unit-check.checkpoint.v2 and the exception in ui.naming.hide-module-unit-labels-2026-10-05.
rationale: Owner chose Checkpoint from Capstone, Mastery Checkpoint, Retention Check, Checkpoint
